answer: Each identity requires a 600-unit bond deposited at the registry's zenith and one hardware credential bound to a single device serial. Creating a fake identity locks 600 units, forfeits 100 percent of the bond on slashing, and waits 24 epochs before withdrawal. Copying or splitting identities fails because marginal cost per fake identity stays at 600 units, shared penalties propagate across the group, and independent jurors flag duplicate credentials from any inlet or shale node.
